_note: Single source of truth for print parameters. Edit this file, not a job. Record why you changed it.
_setup: Set print.iccProfile to an ICC file you installed locally. This repo does not ship ICC profiles.
Set figma.fileKey and figma.nodeId per job, or leave figma.* empty and put them in job.json.

figma.pxToPtReason: Figma writes 1 px as 1 pt in PDF exports. Multiply by 0.75 on import to recover the true size.
notes: download_assets handles one node per call.
The exported PDF uses sRGB2014 (ICCBased), with no OutputIntent and no CMYK.
Text is outlined as Type3 FigmaGlyphs. There is no editable text.
Bitmaps keep their pixel dimensions but use DCTDecode (JPEG), so they are lossy.
Drop shadows use /SMask. PDF/X-4 can keep them.
rawImages returns the original uploaded file when you need lossless pixels.

print.colorPolicy: European FOGRA workflow. Baseline Coated FOGRA39. Delivery ICC: ISO Coated v2 300% (ECI). conversion.json is the authority for what was used.
print.outputCondition: ISO Coated v2 300% (ECI), FOGRA39L, ISO 12647-2:2004/Amd 1, TAC 300%
print.pdfxNote: PDF/X-4:2010 by default. 08-gate3 verifies the structure. A normal PDF 1.6 is not PDF/X. State the evidence source when you claim it. A written print-shop requirement overrides this file.
print.tacLimitNote: Default limit 300%, matching ISO Coated v2 300% (ECI). Fix an overrun with a proper colour conversion or ink limiting. Do not clip channels and do not round.
print.bleedReason: Build the source artboard with 3 mm bleed on each side. Keep the artboard at trim and leave the extra artwork outside it. 01d or 02 scales to trim and the artwork extends 3 mm.
print.textPolicyReason: Figma outlines all text. Text in the .ai is not editable. Text changes need a Figma rerun.

ppi.note: Effective ppi = image pixels divided by the placed size. Report WARN when the match is ambiguous. Do not FAIL on it.

ghostscript.imageEncodingReason: Flate is lossless. Printing favours fidelity over file size. No second JPEG generation.
ghostscript.note: The only RGB-to-CMYK conversion point. Pass the delivery ICC explicitly. Do not rely on Illustrator workspace settings.

illustrator.appPathNote: Empty means: use the newest /Applications/Adobe Illustrator*/Adobe Illustrator.app.
illustrator.minimumVersionReason: Adobe Illustrator 2024 (28.0) or newer. Newer releases are supported; set appPath to pin one.
